The fleet, running

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Renovate proposes and never merges.
A pin nobody merges simply stays pinned — that is the price
of nothing quietly upgrading itself underneath you.
